**Description**
I'm hitting an assert with a message "MaybeODRUseExprs.empty() && "Leftover expressions for odr-use checking""

This started happening after I added typedefs for `vector` and `matrix` with identical identifiers as HLSL's builtins in my own namespace.

**Steps to Reproduce**
I've setup a http://godbolt.devsh.eu which builds latest DXC from trunk, because the official Godbolt is like 5 months behind.

Unfortunately I have no clue if this only happens in SPIR-V out or DXIL too because I don't have a debug build of DXC.exe around.
(I'd kill for a `-print-asserts` option that would print the messages even in Release builds)

Sorry about the long link, we haven't made the short ones work yet (and persist across container updates).

@devshgraphicsprogramming, just an FYI, while compiler explorer doesn't have the more recent HLSL releases. It does have a "trunk" build that is a nightly build. The current version is:
> libdxcompiler.so: 1.8(dev;1-ba90e249)

> @devshgraphicsprogramming, just an FYI, while compiler explorer doesn't have the more recent HLSL releases. It does have a "trunk" build that is a nightly build. The current version is:
> 
> > libdxcompiler.so: 1.8(dev;1-ba90e249)

ok that must have gotten fixed very recently, the "trunk" was severly out of date about one or two months ago
This has `-spirv` in the command line, but it is failing in SEMA. I checked and it fails when `-spirv` is removed, so I'll ask someone from Microsoft to look into it.
Old link takes a long time to load. Here is a modern godbolt link. https://godbolt.org/z/zGaGPaKK3

@s-perron I can't get a repro with the code and compile args in the godbolt link above on my debug built compiler. The code came from what I copied for this bug some time ago. Does it match what you tested with?
I don't think I tried anything other than compiler explorer.

IIRC because its an assert that doesn't crash the compiler, the compilation goes through on Release builds of DXC.

I had a Debug build hooked up to my Godbolt instance, but seems my node's storage got clogged up again (CC: @k3kosz )

I just double checked. If I run the following command using a debug build on my linux box I get the assertion:

```
dxc/6005 » dxc -HV 202x -T cs_6_7 -Zpr -enable-16bit-types -fvk-use-scalar-layout -Wno-c++11-extensions -Wno-c++1z-extensions -Wno-gnu-static-float-init -fspv-target-env=vulkan1.3 -fspv-debug=source -fspv-debug=tool s.hlsl 
Error: assert(MaybeODRUseExprs.empty() && "Leftover expressions for odr-use checking")

/usr/local/google/home/stevenperron/spirv/DirectXShaderCompiler/tools/clang/lib/Sema/SemaDecl.cpp(11119)
Func:   ActOnFinishFunctionBody
[1]    135452 illegal hardware instruction  dxc -HV 202x -T cs_6_7 -Zpr -enable-16bit-types -fvk-use-scalar-layout       
```

This is using the source in the link: https://godbolt.org/z/zGaGPaKK3
